title: Parameter registry of analysis v3.6 (research/detection-time/sweep_analysis_v3_6.py, research/placement/celf_v3_6.py, research/placement/score_test_v3_6.py): TeaStore's off-path epoch teastore-offpath-v1, which v3.3 admits for lanes only, re-admitted as a campaign-E-role epoch for R1 (research/traffic-sweep/BUDGET_TS_PLACEMENT_20261015.md, 2501e86), and the pass rule it is scored under. parameters_v3_3.json, parameters_v3_2.json and parameters_v3.json are not changed; v3.6 reads them as they are. v3.4 (Hotel) and v3.5 (OTel ablation) are other branches of the chain and are not read.
provenanceRule: Protocol decision 37: every hyperparameter is traced to its origin. A separate file, so that parameters_v3_3.json (sha256 a85daa48..., FREEZE_V33_20261014.md) stays byte-identical. Written 2026-10-15 before any cell of the R1 run exists, against the barrier-fixed TeaStore harness 04254228aba90566dfeca603dfcc7b05b7d8d2e3 (plan 5a8e385e..., descriptor 127e8263..., DECLARATION_TEASTORE_OFFPATH_REP2.md 5b9236f), read-only. Every entry is `active`.

parameters.name: V36_EPOCH_PROFILES

design.note: informational, not enforced by the reader

parameters.unit: study-epoch name -> cell profile, in V33_EPOCH_PROFILES's shape; this entry REPLACES v3.3's teastore-offpath-v1 entry for the duration of a v3.6 run and differs from it in exactly one key, role (offpath-teastore -> campaign-E; asserted at import).
parameters.origin_ref: user, 2026-10-15 ~07:00Z ('R1, gated'): a TeaStore off-path placement test on a fresh run trained on blocks 1-3 and scored on blocks 4-5 (BUDGET_TS_PLACEMENT_20261015.md). Every other key is parameters_v3_3.json's (regimes no-fault-cost, recommender-pause-effect -> recommender, auth-freeze-effect -> auth, both pause; 5 blocks, 6 cells per block, 30 cells, 10 and 1 journeys/s; DECLARATION_TEASTORE_OFFPATH.md f40e786).

parameters.name: V36_SPLIT
parameters.origin_ref: BUDGET_TS_PLACEMENT_20261015.md (train 1-3, test 4-5 as F); equal to V32_E_SPLIT (asserted at import); research/protocol/split_ts_offpath.json has the same content (byte-identical to split_f_otel.json).

parameters.name: V36_PASS_RULE
parameters.unit: score_test_v3_2 rule list {set, class, rate, minGain, minImprovedEpisodes, minEpisodes}
parameters.origin_ref: BUDGET_TS_PLACEMENT_20261015.md: F's pass rule (V32_PASS_RULE, decisions 99, 110, 112) mapped to this epoch: the off-path class recommender-pause-effect at each rate (10 and 1 req/s) separately; strictly positive g, strict improvement on >= 2 test episodes of the class at that rate, a dash below 2 valid test episodes (decision 91) or with a member absent (decision 90). auth-freeze-effect (on-path control) has no rule and carries no verdict. Decision 73 unchanged.

parameters.name: V36_TIERS_RULE
parameters.value: TeaStore has no effort/runtime tier file in celf_v3_2's schema: celf_v3_6 is run without one (no --tiers), so every candidate is in tiersMissingForGroundSet and only the (effort<=any, runtime<=any) cell admits it (celf_v3_2.admits: an unknown tier passes only the `any` cap). No tier is invented. The pass rule names that cell.
parameters.origin_ref: research/placement/declared/ has no TeaStore tier file in celf_v3_2's schema (teastore.json is the older family table); F's lag sensor entered only the any/any cell the same way (RESULT_F.md, tiersMissingForGroundSet).
